name: Ms. Pumpkin
dialogue: Wheek, tenant. Etfadaly ta3aly a3melek kobayet shay (plz say no, this is not a serious offer).
Also, rent's due. Still broke, ahlie?
Honestly, dear? You need to leave this neighbourhood and try to make it to Rosedale. Or better yet, Mississauga.
No one pisses on the TTC in Mississauga.
Wheek! What a party. I'm still full.
Your letter's framed on your wall at home, and it's in your mailbox too, dear.

name: 3arbagy
dialogue: Wys, spare a few pickles for your favourite neighbour?
Too broke to give me some money? Once a Scarborough girl, always a Scarborough girl.
I literally steal for a living. My cousin's the Wrestling Raccoon at the gym, so watch yourself.
Best party ever. I only took ONE plate home. Okay, three.
If anyone asks, the leftovers were raccoon-proof.

name: Jiji
dialogue: I'm cheesed cuz manz are asking why I'm Jiji the Jiraffe with a J. Like crodie, can we lowe manz???? Like damn.
Wys tho, let's hit Timz rn.
Newest exhibit is going crazy. Three visitors already. Two of them were me, but still.
Bring more. Mans is tryna fill the whole wall before Yorkville steals the idea.
What a party! I've already started planning the exhibit about it.
It'll need a very tall frame. I know a guy. It's me.

name: Koko
dialogue: Ayy, welcome to Zuzu's Matchacha. Yorkville prices, Scarborough service.
Remember you're broke, so yk... acc try or wtv.
Okay, you can actually whisk. Better foam than mine, styll. Say less.
Come back for another shift. The whisk is lowkey obsessed with you.
Best party ever. I may have had three birthday matchas. For quality control.
The whisk is ready whenever you are.

name: 3am Hossam
dialogue: Gotta learn to scrap, princess. Come in so you're able to work your way around Scarborough.
Bare bugs in my gym and not one of them pays membership. Pick a power-up and handle it.
Saw you in there. Win or lose, you didn't fold. Respect, shordy.
Next time keep your hands up. You were moving like Line 1 on a Sunday.
What a party, champ! I'm still digesting. Training resumes tomorrow. Maybe the day after.
Those bugs won't fight themselves. Well, they might. Come check.

name: Momo
dialogue: Wagwan shordy, come fill your food-obsessed stomach.
My big table's always ready for a celebration. You never know when one's coming, ahlie?
That was the best party my grill has ever seen!
Pop in anytime. The table's still set, and I'm cooking up something fun for later.

name: Jojo
dialogue: What's good? Shooters Drug Mart, inside Don Hills Mall. We got snacks, we got medicine, we got attitude.
Streetcar was late, so I opened late. If the TTC can do it, so can mans.
If a goose comes in, you didn't see me. Me and that goose got history, my word.
Happy birthday again! I brought the hot sauce. Nobody was brave enough.
The goose wasn't invited. I checked twice.

name: Coach Kanga
dialogue: If you're flexible enough to allow yourself to live in this 6ixBuzz highlight reel of a town, you'll be flexible enough for my gymnastics routines.
Yalla wareena shatartek.
Okay, that routine was hard, I'm not even gonna lie. Even the strict judge purred.
Keep that up and you'll make the Olympic team. Or at least the Scarborough Town Centre food court team.
Ten out of ten party. I stuck the landing on the dessert table.
The lawn's all yours whenever you want to tumble off all that food.

name: Sohid
dialogue: Oh. Hi. You can sit here if you want. Everyone leaves eventually anyway.
PAIIIIIIIIIIIIN
I heard you're making drinks now. Maybe one day I'll be worth a drink.
That was a joke. Sort of. Not really.
That party was nice. I almost smiled. Don't tell anyone.
Happy birthday, Zu. I mean it, even if my face doesn't.

name: Bombaclat
dialogue: Wagwan! Bombaclat's Home Goods. I build everything myself. With my teeth. Don't ask.
Your room's looking bare, fam. A rug changes everything, trust.

name: Hazel
dialogue: Darling. Hazel's Threads. That sweater is iconic, but have you considered: a toque?
Fashion is a sport and you're in the playoffs, babe.

name: Parmeet
dialogue: Yo. Parmeet's Anime Den. If you haven't watched Attack on Scarborough, we can't be friends. Kidding. Mostly.
Every poster in here is a masterpiece. No cap. Okay, one cap.

name: Ramy
dialogue: Welcome to Ramy's Salon. New hair, new eyes, new you. Same Zu, obviously.
Sit, sit. Everyone in this mall needs a trim, and Bombaclat chews hers. Don't tell her I said that.
